response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, open-source contributions, and exposure to agentic workflows at re:cinq, but lacks demonstrable production-scale multi-agent AI systems in fintech, regulatory compliance experience, and leadership scaling teams beyond 10 people — critical gaps for an executive CTO role in high-stakes AI fintech.
strengths: Hands-on experience with agentic workflows and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Proven track record in distributed systems, real-time data, and microservices
Strong engineering culture contributions via testing, CI/CD, and open-source tooling
concerns: No evidence of building or operating multi-agent AI systems in regulated fintech environments
Lacks documented experience scaling engineering teams beyond 10–15 people or developing senior technical leadership layers
No mention of financial infrastructure (credit systems, liquidity optimization, compliance frameworks)
